problem: Temporal KGQA models ignore entity transfer caused by temporal constraints and fail to learn specific temporal representations; they also neglect graph structure and explicit multi-hop relationship modeling.
method: Proposes Question Calibration and Multi-Hop Modeling (QC-MHM): calibrate question representation by fusing question and time-constrained concepts in KG; construct GNN layer for multi-hop message passing; combine question representation with GNN embedding output for final prediction.
key_assumptions: Fusing time-constrained concepts improves question representation for temporal KGQA.
GNN layers can effectively perform multi-hop message passing over KG.
main_contribution: QC-MHM achieves better performance than SOTA on benchmark dataset, with Hits@1 and Hits@10 improvements of 5.1% and 1.2% on complex questions, and provides interpretable predictions.
results: ["Hits@1 and Hits@10 improved by 5.1% and 1.2% compared to best-performing baseline on complex questions"]

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: QC-MHM focuses on temporal question calibration and GNN-based multi-hop modeling, whereas the idea enriches target triples with local context subgraphs from source passages, adds an adaptive repair loop for factual reliability, and applies RL transfer from lower-hop QA.
